criteria.description: One content-height section owns one h1, description, email form, legal/terms, landscape trigger/image/scrim/play, and dialog/spinner/iframe without excluded extras
Copy stacks below 768 and forms equal top-aligned columns from 768
Form stacks narrowly and becomes an input-submit row from 640
One full-width landscape trigger follows copy and remains aligned without overflow at 320, 390, 640, 767, 768, and 1280
Loading/loaded states, playable owned media, close, Escape, backdrop, focus trap/restore, unload, and reduced motion work
Visible label, native validation/error, polite success, real GET fallback, and terms destination work
No-JavaScript preserves copy, image, native form, terms, and a real video alternative
Semantic controls, 44px targets, visible focus, light/dark, reduced motion, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Documented Ren10 parts/tokens only; module-scoped JS and root-scoped queries; no framework, Shadow DOM, copied URL, palette token, hardcoded chroma, or duplicate imports
Fresh desktop/mobile closed/open, dark, seam, no-JavaScript, and reduced-motion captures are inspected
